# CS229 unofficial audio preservation edition v1.0

This release preserves the complete 20-lecture Stanford Engineering Everywhere
CS229 Machine Learning course taught by Andrew Ng as podcast-compatible M4A
files. Each file remuxes the original AAC-LC audio stream without decoding or
re-encoding. The canonical master ZIP contains the same 20 files plus a
machine-readable manifest, SHA-256 checksums, provenance, attribution and
licensing documentation.

Source: <https://see.stanford.edu/Course/CS229>

Licence: [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/),
following Stanford Engineering Everywhere's published reuse terms. This is an
independently prepared, non-commercial adaptation. It is not endorsed by
Stanford University or Andrew Ng and does not claim ownership of the source
lectures.

Verify the master ZIP with
`stanford-cs229-machine-learning-audio-edition-v1.0.zip.sha256`, then verify its
contents with the enclosed `SHA256SUMS`. `MANIFEST.json` records per-lecture
source URLs, durations, technical metadata and SHA-256 hashes.

The five local transport ZIPs used during reconstruction are intentionally not
published. The repository history contains no lecture media.
